body:
This PR solves nothing.

> resolve track cache entries by (thash + path + cache type) instead of hash alone

This is already the case with the current hash. Are you using AI?

To resolve this, you need to either increase the hash's bit length to reduce collision probability or utilize a StringName pointer, like https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/110439.

Furthermore, whichever method you choose above, benchmark testing is required to determine if the cost is acceptable.
